title: OpenAI Removes ChatGPT Text Chat Restrictions, GPT-5.6 Series Models Fully Upgraded
excerpt: OpenAI recently announced that it will remove the text chat restrictions for all users of ChatGPT, further expanding the usage scope of the AI assistant. Curren
content_html:
OpenAI recently announced that it will remove the text chat restrictions for all users of ChatGPT, further expanding the usage scope of the AI assistant. Currently, the weekly user count of ChatGPT has exceeded 1 billion, and the new model upgrade will be supported by the new GPT-5.6 series.

The GPT-5.6 Luna will become the default model for Free and Go users, replacing the previous GPT-5.5. In the future, users will also get a new "Think" button, which allows them to actively choose a higher reasoning ability mode for handling more complex problems. OpenAI stated that capabilities such as file processing, image input, voice functions, and image generation will still maintain independent quota limits.

For Plus and Pro users, OpenAI also launched an upgraded GPT-5.6 Sol model. This model is mainly aimed at high-frequency and fast tasks, including daily Q&A, web search, suggestions, planning, writing, and decision support. The official said that it can provide more concise and reliable answers. It should be noted that the GPT-5.6 Sol version used in Codex and Work products has not been adjusted this time.

In addition, Plus and Pro users will also get a "thinking level" slider function, which allows them to adjust the amount of computing power the model invests according to the complexity of the task and the required reasoning steps, to balance response speed and answer depth.

According to internal test data released by OpenAI, compared with GPT-5.5-Instant, the fact error rate of GPT-5.6 Luna has decreased by 62%, and the fact error rate of GPT-5.6 Sol has decreased by 68%. Currently, GPT-5.6 Sol has been opened to Plus and Pro users. The related updates for Free and Go users will be rolled out this week, and it is expected that starting next week, all users can experience unlimited text chatting and the new "Think" feature.

This upgrade further demonstrates OpenAI's direction of pushing AI assistants from simple Q&A tools toward long-term, high-frequency intelligent interaction platforms. As the user base continues to expand, the reliability of models, reasoning capabilities, and optimization of usage quotas have become important factors in the competition of AI products.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI近日宣布将取消ChatGPT所有用户的文字聊天限制，进一步扩大AI助手的使用范围。 目前ChatGPT的周用户数已突破10亿，新型号升级将由全新GPT-5.6系列支持。

GPT-5.6 Luna 将成为 Free 和 Go 用户的默认型号，取代之前的 GPT-5.5。 未来，用户还将获得一个新的“思考”按钮，可以让他们主动选择更高推理能力的模式来处理更复杂的问题。 OpenAI表示，文件处理、图像输入、语音功能、图像生成等能力仍将保持独立的配额限制。

针对Plus和Pro用户，OpenAI还推出了升级版的GPT-5.6 Sol模型。 该模型主要针对高频、快速的任务，包括日常问答、网络搜索、建议、规划、写作和决策支持。 官方表示，可以提供更加简洁可靠的答案。 需要说明的是，Codex 和 Work 产品中使用的 GPT-5.6 Sol 版本本次并未进行调整。

此外，Plus和Pro用户还将获得“思维水平”滑块功能，该功能允许他们根据任务的复杂程度和所需的推理步骤来调整模型投入的计算能力量，以平衡响应速度和答案深度。

根据OpenAI公布的内部测试数据，与GPT-5.5-Instant相比，GPT-5.6 Luna的事实错误率下降了62%，GPT-5.6 Sol的事实错误率下降了68%。 目前，GPT-5.6 Sol已向Plus和Pro用户开放。 Free和Go用户的相关更新将于本周推出，预计下周开始，所有用户都可以体验无限的文字聊天和新的“Think”功能。

此次升级进一步彰显了OpenAI推动AI助手从简单问答工具走向长期高频智能交互平台的方向。 随着用户基数不断扩大，模型的可靠性、推理能力、使用额度的优化等成为AI产品竞争的重要因素。
